stem.en: Sort each description into the assembly it fits.

text.en: Hears a case and gives a judgement
A smaller body of select elites
A larger assembly representing the broader population
A popular gathering of members of the janas

explanation.en: The sabhā was a smaller body of select elites with a mainly judicial function. The samiti was a larger assembly that represented the broader population and focused on policy and political affairs. The vidhata was a popular gathering of members of the janas and a forum for discussing war and other political matters.

hints.en: Three of these are about who attended each assembly. Start with the smallest.
Ask of each chip: is it about judging, about policy, or about discussing war?
